validity.recommendation: Change Owner1 from 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC) to National Iranian Gas Company / Lorestan Gas Company (Sherkat-e Gaz-e Ostan-e Lorestan). Review FuelSource='Kuhdasht' (line branches off the national grid, not a Kuhdasht field). Treat as a small local gas-supply feeder (12 in) rather than a national transmission trunk (caveat).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Confirmed real. A 12-inch, ~50 km Kuhdasht–Pol-e-Dokhtar gas line was built to supply the town of Pol-e-Dokhtar and was executed (routing, mechanical, commissioning) by the contractor Iran Ertebat Co. The GEM row's SOLE citation is iranertebat.com (the contractor's own project listing, 8 backlinks all to one note) — that URL now fails (ConnectTimeout / ECONNREFUSED) and cannot be cited. Independent Persian coverage of gas supply (gazresani) to Pol-e-Dokhtar/Kuhdasht corroborates that this pipe and its purpose exist (yjc.ir), but the exact 12in/50km spec traces to the single contractor origin, so spec corroboration is medium, not high. CLASSIFICATION: This is a small-diameter (12 in) local gas-SUPPLY feeder to a single town, part of provincial gazresani — not a high-pressure national transmission trunk. GEM labels it PipelineType=transmission; that is generous but consistent with how GEM treats the other small Iranian feeders in this cluster (P6021 12in, P6024 10in, P6025 12in, P6030 12/10in), so I flag it as a caveat, not a hard misclassification. DUPLICATE (ruled out): It is NOT the same physical pipe as the 56-inch, ~103 km Pol-e-Dokhtar–Kuhdasht segment of the Ahwaz–Kuhdasht / IGAT-9 national trunk (mehrnews 6388366: 400 km 56in in four segments Ahwaz-Shushtar / Shushtar-Dezful / Dezful-Poldokhtar / Poldokhtar-Kuhdasht, part of the 9th nationwide trunkline). Different diameter (12 vs 56), length (50 vs 103), and function (town supply vs national trunk). Also distinct from the 36-inch Kuhdasht–Khorramabad transmission line. No duplicate ProjectID. ATTRIBUTION (the concern): Owner is recorded as National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC). Domestic gas transmission/supply lines like this are owned/operated by the National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC) and, for provincial supply, its subsidiary Lorestan Gas Company — NIOC is the oil/upstream company. Owner=NIOC is almost certainly wrong and should be NIGC/Lorestan Gas Company. FuelSource='Kuhdasht' is also dubious: the line is fed from the national grid, not a gas field at Kuhdasht. SPEC: length 50 km and diameter 12 in are corroborated but only from the single contractor origin (medium). ProposalYear 2004 / StartYear 2006 could not be independently verified — UNRESOLVED.

fills.researcher_notes: StartLocation was blank while the pipeline name and endpoints establish Kuhdasht (Lorestan) as the start city; gazresani coverage confirms the Kuhdasht–Pol-e-Dokhtar corridor. Left Capacity blank (no defensible independent value; contractor placeholder only).

routes.corridor_desc: Short intra-Lorestan feeder running roughly SSE from the city of Kuhdasht (west-central Lorestan) to the city of Pol-e-Dokhtar (southern Lorestan), broadly following the mountainous Kuhdasht–Pol-e-Dokhtar road corridor. Great-circle distance between the two cities is ~46 km, consistent with the stated 50 km pipe. Endpoints are well-established named cities; the exact routed alignment between them is not published, so the corridor is bounded to the terrain/road between the two cities but not pinned to meters.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoint coordinates are the standard published coordinates of the named cities Kuhdasht and Pol-e-Dokhtar (real places), not fabricated; no intermediate waypoints are sourced so none are asserted. The current sheet endpoints ('Asia'->'Asia') are placeholders; real endpoints are Kuhdasht -> Pol-e-Dokhtar, both Lorestan. No coordinates invented.

summary: P6029 real (12in/50km Kuhdasht–Pol-e-Dokhtar gas-supply feeder built by Iran Ertebat) but CONCERN: Owner NIOC likely wrong (should be NIGC/Lorestan Gas Co); not a duplicate of the 56in IGAT-9 Poldokhtar–Kuhdasht trunk; 'transmission' label generous for a 12in feeder; dates unverified.
